title: CivLabs recommended mods
description: A modpack with the mods recommended by the CivLabs wiki + shaders.
body:
Current text on the wiki:

On the CivLabs server, you are not required to use any mods. However, some are recommended to use, due to their function.

Please note that this list is not official, and was made by players on this server.

Recommended Mods:
This list is intended for use with the Fabric Modloader
Mod Management
Fabric API (Required for most mods to work)
Cloth Config API (Config Screen API used by lots of mods)
Mod Menu (Adds a list of mods you have installed)
Text Placeholder API (Required library)
Optimization
Sodium (Optimization mod)
Lithium (Another optimization mod)
Entity Culling (Optimizes entity loading)
Communication
Simple Voice Chat - THE ONLY OFFICIALLY RECOMMENDED MOD
Sound Physics Remastered (Enhances your sound experience, works well with Simple Voice Chat)
Chat Heads (Makes chat messages show the head of the person talking - very useful for text chat)
Better Tab (Enhances your tab list)
YetAnotherConfigLib (Yet another config library, what else did you expect?)
Other
JEI (Allows you to view items and their recipes)
LambDynamicLights (Handheld lights!)
Iris Shaders (The shader mod)
Notes (Lets you make notes)
